golden_baseline_location: procs/transcripts/plans/PLANS-001..005.json (5 recorded legacy transcripts, pinned by SOURCE_SHA and FIXTURE_SHA in procs/transcripts/), plus federated LIVE comparison of the tables it writes.

acceptance_checks.description: Every money column is DECIMAL(14,2) end to end and reconciles exactly to the cent against the source population (TOL-1). A DOUBLE anywhere in a money lineage rejects the PR.

loaded_rows + quarantined_rows == source_rows for every table in the unit, and the quarantine count is reported next to every money figure (TOL-2). Quarantine above 5% of source rows halts the unit and escalates (STOPA-QUARANTINE).
Rerunning the job with identical inputs produces zero net change: MERGE on the declared key plus ns, proven by a second run whose recon report shows the same row counts and checksums.

Every target row carries ns, every volume path is <ns>/<unit>/..., the job accepts ns as a parameter, and the recon report states the ns it ran under. Nothing unprefixed by ow_tp is read, written or deleted.

All 5 plans transcripts reproduce field-for-field: codes, monthly_fee, plan_code, tier, included_units, subscription_status. A transcript that cannot be reproduced is reported as a failure with the diff, never softened.

The 31-DEC-99 open-ended sentinel resolves to 2099 as the source does (D-05). Java's 80-year pivot yields 1999 and would expire every active subscription; a converted result that closes subscriptions en masse is this bug, not a data finding.
Oracle (+) outer joins are translated preserving direction and the source's null-extension semantics (D-18); a translation that turns an outer join into an inner join silently drops plans.

ROWNUM = 1 without ORDER BY is non-deterministic in source (D-08). Pick the documented deterministic tiebreak, and list the affected path in the recon report's unverified paths rather than claiming parity for it.
trg_sub_no_uncancel is explicit pipeline logic: status_cd 30 (cancelled) can never be changed away from cancelled (STOPA-TRIGGERS), and sp_change_plan's preservation of that status is reproduced.

planted_anomalies.description: 31-DEC-99 used as an open-ended end date.
ROWNUM = 1 selection with no ORDER BY.
Row-by-row subscription close-out loop whose result depends on processing order.

encoding_policy.byte_transparency: Values are carried through as Unicode text without re-encoding; no transliteration, no NFC/NFD normalisation, no whitespace trimming. A trailing-space-padded CHAR column keeps its padding.
encoding_policy.invalid_bytes: Unconvertible bytes are not silently replaced: the row is quarantined with reason ENC_INVALID and counted in recon.

malformed_record_policy.details: Source NULL and empty string are distinct and must stay distinct: a NULL stays NULL, a zero-length VARCHAR2 stays zero-length. Never coalesce NULL to '' or to 0 to make a comparison pass. An unexpected extra column from the source fails the unit rather than being ignored, because a schema drift no one declared is a correctness event.

empty_input_semantics.details: A tenant with no subscriptions yields an empty result set, not a NULL row and not a skipped tenant; the transcripts include this shape.
